items: Elegant Flowy Silhouette & Comfortable Fabric - Crafted from lightweight polyester crepe, this top offers an effortlessly elegant and flowy drape that flatters every figure. The fabric is incredibly soft, breathable, and naturally wrinkle-resistant, ensuring all-day comfort and easy care, whether you're at the office or out for leisure.

Chic Petal Sleeves for a Feminine Touch - Elevate your style with the unique, petal-shaped short sleeves. This delicate design detail adds a romantic, feminine flair to the top, beautifully balancing sophistication with a touch of sweet, playful charm.

Versatile V-Neck & Full Lining for a Polished Look - Featuring a subtly professional V-neck that elongates the neckline for a sleek appearance. The top is fully lined, providing premium opacity, a smooth feel against the skin, and a structured, high-quality finish that looks impeccable under blazers or on its own.

items.label: Two Stylish Designs
items.value: Solid & Floral Print - Choose from a range of sophisticated solid colors for a classic, versatile staple or opt for our beautiful floral prints to express your personal style. This variety allows you to easily build a wardrobe that transitions seamlessly from day to night.

items: Effortless Style for Any Occasion - Designed for the modern woman, this top is the perfect blend of office-ready professionalism and weekend-ready chic. Pair it with tailored pants for a meeting or with your favorite jeans for a casual outing—it's the ultimate go-to piece for a polished yet comfortable look.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: HAND WASH OR MACHINE WASH ON A LOW TEMPERATURE WITHOUT SOAKING OR SCRUBBING, and air-dry it away from DIRECT SUNLIGHT. Do not bleach, and avoid washing it with items that have sharp accessories, like zippers or buttons. When drying, GENTLY PRESS OUT EXCESS WATER instead of wringing.
